correctness.rationale: The invariant-simplicial-face Lefschetz orientation is reconstructed, including the augmented empty face. All allowed extra orbits are enumerated by 1- and 2-covers; a complete star/2-hub case analysis proves the only nonzero weights are one edge, two edges, triangle and square. Exact graph counts give Ltilde=C(m−1,3) for every m, not an extrapolation from computation. Jonsson Theorem 7.1 supplies exact H3/H4 rank and concentration; the published four-subset sphere result supplies H4 character. Subtraction and rational averaging yield the stated character and quotient ranks. The independent verifier enumerates every eligible outside graph for m=4..8 and every invariant simplex for m=4..7; all checks pass. It does not assert full S_m action or integral torsion.

value.rationale: A transposition is the simplest geometrically canonical nontrivial symmetry of the two-subset Čech/covering family. The infinite-parameter split of H3 into invariant and anti-invariant pieces resolves a symmetry quantity that the known Betti ranks and complete H4 permutation representation do not determine. It produces natural exact rational Betti ranks of the geometric involution quotients and a structural fixed-point Euler classification with a nontrivial exceptional four-cycle term. This is not a mere normalization check or isolated numerical table.
